lines.text: Help us, O God of our salvation,
for the glory of Your name;
deliver us and atone for our sins,
for the sake of Your name.
Before our eyes, make known among the nations
Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
May the groans of the captives reach You;
by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
Pay back into the laps of our neighbors
sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture,

pictures.scene: Gyula Benczúr, The Baptism of Vajk — the prince kneeling down bareheaded to be washed before the whole court, help us O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name
pictures.name: pd_benczur_baptism_vajk

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbarán, Crucifixion — the Lord hanging alone against the darkness where the price was paid, deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_crucifixion

pictures.scene: Giovanni Paolo Panini, Interior of the Pantheon Rome — the temple the nations built for all their own gods, standing open and empty under its one light, why should the nations ask where is their God
pictures.name: pd_panini_pantheon_interior

pictures.scene: Gustave Doré, L'Énigme — the winged one on the hill above the burning city questioning the stone face, with the slain lying all around, before our eyes make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants
pictures.name: pd_dore_lenigme

pictures.scene: Nikolai Yaroshenko, Everywhere There Is Life — the prisoners crowded at the barred window of the locked car, feeding the birds on the boards below, may the groans of the captives reach You
pictures.name: pd_yaroshenko_vsyudu_zhizn

pictures.scene: Quentin Metsys, Le prêteur et sa femme — the balance held up over the counted coins until the weight is exact, by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death, pay back into the laps of our neighbors
pictures.name: pd_metsys_preteur_et_sa_femme

pictures.scene: Jean-Honoré Fragonard, Landscape with Shepherds and Flock of Sheep — the flock brought down the hillside with the shepherd keeping them together, then we Your people the sheep of Your pasture will thank You forever
pictures.name: pd_fragonard_shepherds_flock

pictures.scene: Carl Larsson, Namnsdag på härbret — the children of the house coming up in procession with their garlands and flowers to honor the old, from generation to generation we will declare Your praise
pictures.name: pd_larsson_namnsdag_pa_harbret
